items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Parnassus So anyway, when we got to France, met us and he had hired a tenor player...

ctx.x: You started with a good stomache.

Yes. I still might have a sea stomache, I don't know. But I know that boat used to rock and all I'd just roll with it, I hever would get, I never got dizzy. The only time you get dizzy is drinking that red wine that they keep putting in front of you for dinner. You drink red wine with the dinner, before the dinner and after dinner and then you try to get back to your cabin. Parnassus So anyway, when we got to France, met us and he had hired a tenor player, an alto player and a bass player.
